articles.title: Not just Ford Motor, Australia's biggest bank too 'regretted' AI layoffs; said: We should have been more thorough in our ...
articles.description: Ford is bringing back experienced engineers to fix its AI tools after realizing that human expertise is crucial for effective artificial intelligence. This move follows similar AI missteps by companies like IBM and Commonwealth Bank of Australia, which had to reverse job cuts after AI systems failed to perform. Ford's initiative has already boosted its vehicle quality, demonstrating the value of seasoned professionals in overcoming technological challenges.
